resources.name: The Joint Mushaf of Riyadh Reciters
resources.name_ar: المصحف المشترك لقراء الرياض
resources.short_description:
The Joint Mushaf of Riyadh Reciters is a unique and collaborative Quranic audio project that brings together a distinguished group of prominent reciters and mosque Imams from the city of Riyadh to recite the entire Holy Quran.

Key Features of this Mushaf:

Narration (Riwayah): The recitations are recorded in the universally recognized transmission of Hafs 'an 'Asim.

Recitation Style: It is specifically recited using the rule of "Qasr al-Munfasil" (shortening the disconnected elongation). This means the optional disconnected elongation (Madd Ja'iz Munfasil) is shortened to just two beats instead of the standard four or five.

Purpose and Impact: The project aims to showcase the vocal diversity and beautiful recitation styles of Riyadh's Imams in a single, unified release. Thanks to the application of Qasr al-Munfasil, the recitation maintains a smooth, moderately fast pace. This makes it an ideal choice for memorizers who want to revise their Quran, or for listeners who wish to complete a full listening of the Quran in a shorter timeframe without compromising the rules of Tajweed.

resources.name: Al-Jami' Al-Wajeez fi Tafsir Ay Al-Kitab Al-Aziz
resources.name_ar: الجامع الوجيز في تفسير آي الكتاب العزيز
resources.short_description: Al-Jāmiʿ al-Wajīz fī Tafsīr Āyi al-Kitāb al-ʿAzīz by Dr. Ayman Fateh al-Amer is a concise commentary on the whole Quran, from al-Fatiha to an-Nas (114 surahs, 6,236 verses). It distills eight authoritative works into a single reference: Ibn Kathir, Safwat al-Bayan, Zubdat al-Tafsir, al-Saʿdi, al-Jalalayn, the Ten Recitations, and the books of the occasions of revelation by al-Suyuti and al-Wahidi. Each surah opens with an introduction and its virtues, and each verse is explained with related verses, hadiths, occasions of revelation, variant readings, and doctrinal, jurisprudential, and linguistic benefits. It has been approved by the Association of Senior Muslim Scholars and endorsed by the review committee at Dar Ihya al-Turath al-Islami in Qatar.

resources.name: Sciences of the Surahs from Al-Jami' Al-Wajeez
resources.name_ar: علوم السور من كتاب الجامع الوجيز في تفسير آي الكتاب العزيز
resources.short_description: ʿUlūm al-Suwar (Surah Studies): 114 records, one per surah, from Al-Jāmiʿ al-Wajīz by Dr. Ayman Fateh al-Amer. Each gives the surah's type, verse count, name, virtues, and occasions of revelation.

resources.name: Word-by-Word Meanings of the Holy Quran's Vocabulary
resources.name_ar: معاني مفردات القرآن الكريم كلمة كلمة
resources.short_description: A Word-by-Word Explanation of the Holy Quran's Vocabulary from Reliable Linguistic and Exegetical Sources. Prepared by Engineer and Researcher Bashir Ahmad Sulaiman Yunus.

resources.name: Tajweed Rulings on the Words of the Qur’an
resources.name_ar: أحكام التجويد في كلمات العزيز الحميد
resources.short_description: This book follows the words of the Qur’an page by page in the margins of the Madinah Mushaf, noting next to each word its most prominent tajweed ruling. The rulings include ghunnah, idgham, ikhfa’ and iqlab, lengthening and shortening of madd, selected rules of stopping and starting, and features of the Mushaf’s script such as omitted and retained letters, joined and separated words, and the feminine ta’. It pays particular attention to the effects of shortening the separated madd (al-madd al-munfasil). The author states each ruling briefly, without detailed explanation, so that readers can apply it while reciting. Because the rulings recur across consecutive verses, readers build a lasting habit of correct pronunciation. The book follows the riwayah of Hafs from Asim via the Shatibiyyah route.
